summary: Serialize migration execution across PostgreSQL sessions
details: Hold one schema-scoped session advisory lock across the migration run, using the same pooled connection for tracking, version checks and each migration transaction.
Preserve cancellation and failed-transaction rollback while releasing owned work; discard physical connections after uncertain acquisition, transaction state or unlock results.
Return cleanup uncertainty as an error, including when a migration version already committed, and document cooperative-runner and per-file transaction limits.

compatibility.notes: Recorded versions and SQL files are unchanged. Updated runners on the same schema serialize; older programs do not participate. Earlier completed versions survive later failures. Cleanup failure may return an error after a version commits, so retain the migration outcome and retry only the same reviewed artifacts.

security: One owned database session carries the advisory lock and migration transactions. Cancellation cannot return an uncertain session-scoped lock to the pool, and rollback/unlock cleanup has independent bounded contexts.
limitations: This does not make an entire multi-file migration run atomic or authenticate migration inputs; immutable snapshots, explicit targets, checksums and legacy-row treatment remain in EVY-1206.
Read-only startup checks, the dedicated release migration job, audited worker operations and deployment/runbook qualification remain incomplete.
